title: QUANTEC normal-tissue dose/volume constraints (2010)
description: Selected constraints from the QUANTEC series, Int J Radiat Oncol Biol Phys 2010;76(3 Suppl). Conventional fractionation (approximately 2 Gy per fraction) unless the entry says otherwise. These are orientation values for a single organ at a time; they are not a plan-acceptance standard and they do not compose.
applicability: Conventional fractionation, photon external-beam. Not applicable to SBRT/SRS, re-irradiation, or paediatric patients without separate justification.
maintainer_review: pending: not verified against primary sources
